rationale.text: A page written in French whose html element carries lang="fr". fr is a 2-character ISO 639-1 code, so the code is valid, and it names the language the page is written in, so it is relevant. The test is met. The tool examines only validity: the custom check answers no_fault, and relevance has no check, so the finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, and alternative_unresolved at full, where the relevance requirement stays unresolved.

citations.quote: Le code de langue est valide ;
Le code de langue est pertinent.
Code de 2 caractères (ISO 639-1) ou 3 caractères (ISO 639-2 et suivants) permettant d’indiquer la langue d’un document ou d’un passage de texte.
Et pertinent (qui indique la langue principale du document).
